Privacy & Cookies

Last updated: 23 January 2026

Who we are

DJ Auto Care Detailing is a mobile car detailing service. This page explains how we handle personal information when you use our website or contact us.

What information we collect

We may collect information you choose to share when you contact us, such as:

  • Your name
  • Your phone number or email address
  • Your message and any details about your vehicle/service request

How we use your information

We use your information to:

  • Respond to enquiries and provide quotes
  • Arrange bookings and communicate about your appointment
  • Provide customer support

Cookies

Our website may use essential cookies required for the site to function properly. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies for marketing purposes.

Analytics

We may use privacy-friendly analytics (for example, via Cloudflare) to understand website traffic and improve the site. This is used to see general trends (like page visits) and is not intended to identify individual visitors.

Sharing your information

We do not sell your personal information. We only share information when it’s necessary to provide our service (for example, replying via email/WhatsApp) or if required by law.

How long we keep your information

We keep enquiry/booking messages only for as long as needed to deal with your request and for basic record-keeping.

Your rights

You can request access to the personal information we hold about you, ask for corrections, or request deletion where appropriate.

Contact

If you have any questions about this policy, contact us at:
Email: dylansmith@djautocaredetailing.uk
